user.title: What Should I Wear?
user.description: Pick the weather entity to base advice on and how far ahead to look. Add people (with their own comfort thresholds) afterwards.

data_description.weather_entity: Must provide an hourly forecast (e.g. OpenWeatherMap).
data_description.lookahead_hours: How many hours ahead the advice considers.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the forecast is refreshed (seconds).

abort.already_configured: What Should I Wear? is already set up.

data_description.sandals_min_temp: Sandals are advised when it is at least this warm and dry.
data_description.jacket_max_temp: A jacket is advised when it drops to this or below within the lookahead window.
data_description.rain_prob_threshold: Rain gear is advised when precipitation probability reaches this.
data_description.umbrella_over_rainjacket: When off, a rain jacket is recommended instead. In strong wind a rain jacket is always recommended.
